summary: Iteration 4 frontend testing for ShareDialog with QR code feature. All 14 test steps passed: share dialog opens from ResultsPanel and HistoryList, QR code SVG renders, share URL follows origin+?s=<base64> format, badge shows 'NEUTRAL · Score 64', 3 action buttons work (copy shows Check icon for 2s then reverts, download QR emits toast without crashing, native share falls back to clipboard when navigator.share is undefined). Escape closes dialog cleanly. Compare regression works. SharedView renders WorthitMeter without exposing raw salary (10.000.000 not present in DOM).
critical_code_review_comments: ShareDialog.jsx handleDownloadQR: no error handler on img.onerror; if SVG serialization fails, no toast/feedback given.
Recharts warning 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' shows in console on initial load (ProjectionChart). Minor, not blocking.
seed_data_creation: None. History records created client-side via IndexedDB during test only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ShareDialog verified end-to-end incl. QR SVG rendering (qrcode.react 4.2.0), URL format https://...?s=<base64_urlsafe>, copy/download/native-share buttons, close via Escape, share-from-history opens same dialog, compare regression intact, SharedView privacy preserved.
